Is this the calm before the next move or just digestion after the hack?

One of the most underrated crypto skills is knowing what NOT to touch.

You don't need exposure to every narrative.
You don't need every airdrop.
You don't need to trade every market.

Selectivity is a strategy, not a weakness.

The most underrated crypto feature? A calm exit button 🚪🛠️
